notablePrerequisites: Three or more creatures have been put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
description:
Cast Caller of the Claw.
Caller of the Claw's trigger resolves creating at least 3 bear tokens with vigilance counters.
Sacrifice Caller of the Claw to Ashnod's Altar.
Pay {3} and remove three vigilance counters from among bear tokens you control to activate Tayam.
Sacrifice one bear token to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Mill 3 and return Caller of the Claw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
